'''September 2000 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Kards 4 You, Tucson, AZ in September 2000. [[Steve Marshall]] won it. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1215">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoy], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 10 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-10-two-az-tournaments-for-you-to-enjoyd1215/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 2000
* '''Site:''' Kards 4 You, Tucson, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Marshall]]
